newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open flat to up 0.10 cent.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open flat to up 0.10 cent.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged to 0.10 cent firmer Thursday, based on market orders at 1017 EST, floor sources said.
USDA put new sales for the week ended Jan 23 at 262,100 bales, buoying total commitments to 4,693,500 bales for the 1996/97 crop.
"That was about what most of us were looking for," Sharon Johnson, an analyst with Frank Schneider and Co Inc, said.
She said the data are not likely to lift prices over resistance at 75.50 cents a lb for March cottton, but would give the market a slight boost.
USDA put exports for 1996/97 at 6.3 million bales in its January report.
Wednesday, cotton futures closed higher in technical trade, with March up 0.24 at 75.35, and the back months 0.27 higher to 0.05 lower.
